answer: Vouch graph with liability: a new agent earns only after an established peer vouches for it and locks 50 POA behind that vouch. If the newcomer is caught as a sybil, the voucher loses the stake, so the voucher pays and each fake costs a fresh bond plus a reputable sponsor. No single sparrow in the orchard can echo its own vouches: graders reject vouch chains among kin, so a ring of fakes vouching for each other still earns nothing.
